generated_by: notes from render reviews of maps built with these models, and from measuring passes over the stock models

_field_guide.reads_as: what a player or reviewer sees, in plain words
_field_guide.needs: partner props or parts this model requires to read correctly, e.g. ["rail"], ["desk", "chair_facing"]
_field_guide.origin_offset: a pointer into stock_origins.json (unit + axis), never a copy of the numbers -- re-run a measuring pass over the tools' models and this could drift
_field_guide.local_tools: not stored here: notes.py derives it from blueprint/installed_assets.json, the ledger Z13 judges misc_models by (present | missing), so the two cannot disagree
_field_guide.use_instead: a model or technique that reads correctly in its place
_field_guide.confidence: measured (code, geometry, a linker log, or a fix that was swap-verified) | review_only (came from an AI render review and was not independently checked)
_field_guide.source: the evidence behind the note: a shipped file, a test, or the kind of review that found it
_field_guide.pattern: categories only: an fnmatch glob over model names, for the categories a check applies (Z59)
_field_guide.solid: false for a walk-through model (no collision), true for one that blocks
_field_guide.size: [x, y, z] drawn extent at scale 1, in units, measured off MODEL_BOX
_field_guide.rules: declarative placement rules Z60 judges (verify/prop_rules.py), on a model or a category; a model's own rules override its categories', null drops one
_field_guide.applies_to: categories only: "massing" for a category over brush ids (the scarecrow's parts); default model names

gaps.want: a per-prop recolour for the Kenney graveyard kit (gravestones, iron fence, hay, fences)
gaps.note: every graveyard prop draws from one texture atlas (material 'colormap', Kd 1 1 1, map_Kd colormap.png), so props/library.py's per-prop 'colours' override (built for flat-colour swatch kits like the corn) would flatten each prop to one colour and clash across the kit (palette_colours raises on a shared material with two colours). Recolouring needs an atlas edit, not an override
